# /server/tests/fixtures/html/

Saved real ATS form HTML — the golden-fixture corpus.

## Purpose

Phase 0 deliverable: saved HTML from 10+ real job application forms.
Used for:
- Testing DOM scanning, field extraction, and constraint parsing
- Regression testing adapter selectors after ATS UI updates
- Validating fill verification across framework patterns

## Target ATS families

- Greenhouse (boards.greenhouse.io) — Phase 1
- Lever (jobs.lever.co) — Phase 2
- Ashby (jobs.ashbyhq.com) — Phase 2

> Save complete page HTML, not fragments. Include React/Angular bundle artifacts.
